name: ai-orb-face
title: AI Orb Face
description: A round painted orb with two dark eyes that blinks, follows the pointer and swaps expression for idle, listening, thinking, streaming, done and error. A row of pills under it switches the state.
use: An AI chat or voice assistant needs a friendly character that shows listening, thinking and done at a glance.
avoid: It runs a WebGL shader continuously, so many on one page tax the GPU, and the eyes-only face may not fit a formal brand.
a11y: Honours reduced motion and takes an aria-label, but expression changes and state are not announced to screen readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A lavender-purple sphere lit from the upper left on a black stage, with two dark vertical capsule eyes. Below it a dark rounded control bar holds six small state labels, the active one set in a white pill.
behaves: The eyes blink at random and follow the pointer; thinking narrows one eye and darts the gaze away, done closes both into flat arcs while the body hops and stretches, and error replaces them with spinning spirals. Clicking a state pill switches the face.
customise: State and expression come from props, plus size, colours, a gaze toggle and a live amplitude value. The eye shapes are preset, so a new face means editing the source.
weight: heavy: A WebGL2 shader redraws the marbled orb every frame while it is on screen.
demo: Six state buttons: Idle, Listening, Thinking, Streaming, Done, Error.
issues: Inactive state labels are dim grey on dark and read poorly at this size.
polishWhy: Distinctive marbled orb with readable expressions; inactive selector labels are low contrast.
